correctness.rationale: The trace pairing restricted to odd-characteristic symmetric and skew subspaces is nondegenerate, yielding the exact Fourier coefficient q^(s+d(Z)). Any nonzero 3x3 skew matrix has rank two and square nonzero, hence minimal polynomial degree three, cyclic centralizer k[Z], and exactly two symmetric centralizing basis elements I and Z². Thus the transform is q^12 at zero and q^8 elsewhere, and character inversion proves both complete fibers and total mass q^12. In dimension four, Z1=J+0 and Z2=J+tJ with t²≠1 have symmetric centralizer dimensions four and two, contradicting nonzero uniformity. The embedded independent C++17 and Python 3 programs verify the q=3,5,7 exact target spectra and a q=5 dimension-four witness; finite checks are supplemental only.
